description: Can this instrument or issuer be traded, custodied or accepted as collateral: ISIN / CUSIP / SEDOL / ticker resolved through OpenFIGI to the issuer, then the issuer against OFAC NS-CMIC (Chinese military-industrial complex: no purchase or sale of their securities), OFAC sectoral sanctions (new debt / equity restrictions), the sanctions lists, SEC trading suspensions and enforcement history. Returns allow / review / block with reasons and references. Use for pre-trade compliance, onboarding of collateral and tokenised securities, and investment restriction lists.
